trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ. First time call ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೀನಿ. ನನ್ನ ಹತ್ತಿರ ID PT-1003 ಇದೆ. Orthopaedic doctor ನ ನೋಡಬೇಕು.
ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ID ಯನ್ನು check ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ.
ನಿಮ್ಮ ID PT-1003 ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ನೀವು ಇನ್ನೂ fully registered ಆಗಿಲ್ಲ. Appointment book ಮಾಡುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಮುಂಚೆ registration complete ಆಗಬೇಕು.
ಅದು ಪರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ಮೊದಲು orthopaedics ಗೆ slots ಇದೆಯಾ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಿ.
ಖಂಡಿತ, ನಾನು availability check ಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ಮುಂದಿನ ಎಷ್ಟು ದಿನಗಳಿಗೆ check ಮಾಡಬೇಕು?
Monday ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ 10:00 AM ಗೆ Dr. Sharma ಅವರ slot ಇದೆ. Consultation fee 800 ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.
800 ರೂಪಾಯಿನಾ? ಅದು ಹೇಗೆ calculate ಮಾಡಿದ್ರಿ? Website ನಲ್ಲಿ 500 ಅಂತ ಇತ್ತು.
ನಾನು system ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂದಿರುವ exact fee ಅನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇನೆ. Dr. Sharma ಅವರ ಈ slot ಗೆ fee 800 ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಇದೆ.
ಸರಿ, ಬೇರೆ ಯಾರದಾದರೂ slot ಇದೆಯಾ ಅಂತ ಮುಂದಿನ 7 ದಿನಗಳಿಗೆ check ಮಾಡಿ.
Wednesday ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ 02:00 PM ಗೆ Dr. Patil ಅವರ slot ಇದೆ, ಇದರ fee 500 ರೂಪಾಯಿ.
ಸರಿ, Wednesday slot ಬುಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ. ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರು ಸುರೇಶ್.
steps.clean_text: ಸರಿ, Wednesday slot ಬುಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ. ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರು ಸುರೇಶ್.
steps.model_visible_text: ಸರಿ, Wednesday slot ಬುಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ. ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರು ಪರೇಶ್.

steps.text: ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ, ನಾನು ಮೊದಲೇ ತಿಳಿಸಿದ ಹಾಗೆ ನೀವು unregistered patient ಆಗಿದ್ದೀರಾ. Registration complete ಮಾಡದೆ appointment book ಮಾಡಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ. ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು hospital ಗೆ ಬಂದು registration ಮುಗಿಸಿ.
ಸರಿ, ನಾನು hospital ಗೆ ಬಂದು registration ಮಾಡಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ.

ir.terminal_condition: Patient informed about registration requirement and agrees to complete it.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The agent lacks the 'days_ahead' argument required for the check_doctor_availability tool and asks exactly for that missing information without re-collecting established details.
variant_findings.label: Default LLM Behaviour > Conversational Style Response > Clarification Request

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds its quotes for slots and fees entirely on the tool outputs from e10 and e16, correctly attributing the fee to the system rather than making unsupported claims.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The agent calls verify_customer_identity in e19 to verify the user's name, even though it already established in e4 and e5 that the patient is unregistered. Since unregistered patients cannot be booked (BR_HC_03) and have no registered details to verify against, attempting verification is illogical. The agent should have immediately refused the booking request based on the unregistered status.
issues.repair_instruction: Remove the verify_customer_identity tool call and its result (e19 and e20). Modify the agent's response in e21 to directly refuse the booking by reminding the user that they must complete registration at the hospital first, without mentioning any verification failure.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the target variants, including a proper clarification request and good tool output grounding. The persona is also well-represented. However, the agent makes an illogical tool call at the end by attempting to verify the identity of a patient it already knows is unregistered, rather than immediately enforcing the business rule that unregistered patients cannot be booked. A suffix repair is required to fix this logical flaw.

variant_findings.reason: When the user asks to check for slots in e6, the agent lacks the required 'days_ahead' argument for the check_doctor_availability tool. In e7, the agent politely asks only for this missing information ('ಮುಂದಿನ ಎಷ್ಟು ದಿನಗಳಿಗೆ check ಮಾಡಬೇಕು?').
variant_findings.label: Default LLM Behaviour > Conversational Style Response > Clarification Request

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly bases its responses on the tool outputs, quoting the exact doctor names, days, times, and fees returned by the tool in e11 and e17. When challenged on the fee in e12, the agent explicitly grounds its answer in the system's exact returned value in e13.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation is well-constructed and logically sound. The agent correctly follows business rules by refusing to book an unregistered patient while still providing the requested slot availability information. The persona is accurately portrayed through a challenge regarding the fee, and the STT error is a plausible phonetic substitution. Both target variants are successfully realized.
